layout.provenance: engineering: table height/size, pedestal and camera placement; patient body dimensions come from the asset bounding box

supine.rotation: Rz(yaw) @ Rz(90) @ Rx(-90): supine, head toward -X, chest toward +Z, patient left toward +Y (rig faces -Y when standing)
supine.provenance: engineering: supine root rotation + table height; body dimensions come from the M_Medical_01 asset bounding box

landmark_audit.provenance: asset_measurement: biped_demo rig joint world positions (simulation GT)
landmark_audit.note: Raw asset measurements from the bare-body biped_demo rig. The rig has no breast or rib joints, so intercostal levels are not available here by construction; they must be measured or learned.

provenance.anterior: clinical_definition: lateral x up; sign from anterior_hint
provenance.origin: asset_measurement: midpoint of L/R_Clavicle (sternoclavicular joints); proxy for the top of the sternum
provenance.caveat: The rig chest bones are skinning joints, not individual ribs; clinical rib levels are applied with the documented uncertainty in configs/ecg_rules.yaml.

surface.note: mesh source uses rest-pose asset points transformed by the human root; the chest is unaffected by the arms-only pose
